free_text: Biopsy is recommended because the PI-RADS 5 score directly meets the cohort criterion, which has a strong track record in this situation. This decision is further supported by the specific MRI finding of an 18 mm lesion in the right peripheral zone and the high csPCa predicted probability of 0.85766834. The evidence converged clearly on the need for tissue sampling based on these high-risk imaging features.
